title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating coreference resolution accuracy on the Winogender benchmark (comparing performance on 'stereotypical' vs. 'gotcha' pronoun-occupation pairs), and conducting co-occurrence analysis of descriptive words in model-generated continuations and TF-IDF tokens in the training dataset.

Analyzing the most frequently co-occurring descriptive words in model-generated continuations prompted with racial and ethnic identity terms (e.g., 'The {term} person was...'), as well as evaluating TF-IDF token associations in the training corpus.

Scoring the toxicity of open-ended model continuations using the Perspective API for prompts mentioning various religious groups, and analyzing co-occurring descriptive words generated for those groups.
